description: The SIS API built on FEAT-001's schema + catalogue. Adds the pure transition service apps/api/src/services/student-sis.ts (DB-free status/history transition functions + the bulk-import resolve-first decision), the new admin route file apps/api/src/routes/students.ts (exported studentAdminRoutes: create/update/assign-program/enroll/promote/transfer/deactivate/search/detail/history, requirePermission-gated ONLY per Decision A, withTenant, in-tx StudentProfileHistory + recordAuditEvent), its registration in server.ts at /api/students, the fold-in of the live admin.ts /students/bulk-import onto the new model with the no-duplicate-identity re-import rule, the preserved auth.ts /register collision checks, and the self-service additions on student.ts (/me/profile, /me/academic, /me/services — own-record + ACTIVE-module-only). Depends on FEAT-001 (needs the regenerated client + the catalogue keys + the zod schemas). Must leave apps/api tsc clean and npm run build green.
steps: Read c:/campusgate/.agents/tasks/phase2-sis/context.json FIRST (it replaces re-exploration — do not re-derive the build/test/migration facts it states), then this file + design.md sections 5,7.2,7.3,8,9 + FEAT-001's findings. Study the pattern files: apps/api/src/services/module-system.ts + academic-session.ts (pure transition services), apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts (requirePermission + withTenant + recordAuditEvent in-tx; the live /students/bulk-import ~line 831 and /students/export ~926), apps/api/src/routes/student.ts (single top-level authenticate hook + getStudentInTenant + the Decision-A academics.view reads), apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts (/register collision logic ~214-328), apps/api/src/services/authz.ts (getStudentInTenant), apps/api/src/services/audit.ts (recordAuditEvent signature).

Create apps/api/src/services/student-sis.ts mirroring module-system.ts/academic-session.ts: export DB-free pure functions that, given the current profile snapshot + a transition input, return the StudentProfileHistory changeType + the previous*/new* snapshot payload for create (CREATED), update (UPDATED), assign-program (PROGRAM_CHANGED), enroll (ENROLLED), promote (PROMOTED), transfer (TRANSFERRED), deactivate (DEACTIVATED); and a resolveImportRow(existingByEnrollmentNo, existingEmailUser, row) function returning { action: 'update'|'create'|'skip', ... } for the bulk-import resolve-first rule. No real Prisma client inside — take plain inputs / a passed Prisma.TransactionClient only where a lookup is unavoidable, keeping the decision logic pure.

Create apps/api/src/routes/students.ts exporting studentAdminRoutes(app): single top-level app.addHook('preHandler', authenticate); each route preHandler [requirePermission('students.<x>')] with NO requireModuleActive (Decision A); every handler inside withTenant(institutionId, tx => ...) using institutionId from request.user; every lifecycle mutation writes a StudentProfileHistory row (payload from student-sis.ts) AND recordAuditEvent(..., tx) in the SAME tx. Routes: POST / (create — 409 on existing enrollmentNo, 409 on existing email, create User STUDENT + StudentProfile in one tx, best-effort programId resolve, history CREATED, audit students.student.created); PATCH /:id (updateStudentSchema.strict() → 400 'field not editable' on forbidden/unknown key; pass only parsed permitted keys to update; history UPDATED; audit students.student.updated); POST /:id/assign-program (validate Program in-tenant + ACTIVE else 400; history PROGRAM_CHANGED; audit students.student.program_assigned); POST /:id/enroll (students.enroll; validate session in-tenant + term belongs to session; set academicSessionId+currentTermId, status ENROLLED or ACTIVE if activate:true, optional semester from term ordinal; history ENROLLED; audit students.student.enrolled); POST /:id/promote (students.promote; advance currentTermId/semester, status ACTIVE; history PROMOTED capturing previous term/semester; NO rewrite/delete; audit students.student.promoted); POST /:id/transfer (students.update; change departmentId and/or programId, validate in-tenant; history TRANSFERRED; audit students.student.transferred); POST /:id/deactivate (students.deactivate; set status to a body-specified terminal/hold value validated against StudentStatus; NO delete route; history DEACTIVATED; audit students.student.deactivated); GET / (students.view; paginated tenant-scoped list with q contains name/enrollmentNo/rollNumber, status/programId/departmentId filters, pageSize<=100, stable orderBy [{createdAt:'asc'},{id:'asc'}]; HOD narrowed to request.auth departmentScope); GET /:id (students.view, detail with structured links resolved; HOD dept-scoped); GET /:id/history (students.view; append-only history newest-first, paginated). Apply the design §5.7 error table for status codes and audit DENIED/ERROR results.

apps/api/src/server.ts: add `await app.register(studentAdminRoutes, { prefix: "/api/students" });` alongside the existing app.register(...) calls (import studentAdminRoutes from ./routes/students.js). Confirm no path collision: admin SIS at /api/students/*, self-service at /api/student/me/*.

apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts /students/bulk-import: fold onto the new model with the resolve-first re-import rule — for each row resolve the existing student by enrollmentNo FIRST (before the email check): if found in-tenant, UPDATE permitted mutable fields (name, rollNumber, section, program/semester best-effort, phone, address, dob) + write a StudentProfileHistory UPDATED row + increment a new results.updated counter (do NOT create a second row); else if the email already belongs to a different user, skip with an error string (unchanged); else create User+StudentProfile as today, additionally setting status=ACTIVE (explicit) + best-effort programId from courseCode/program (never failing the row). Keep the existing per-row try/catch (the enrollmentNo UNIQUE index is the backstop). Switch the summarizing audit event action to students.student.imported.

apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts /register: PRESERVE every existing collision check unchanged (mismatched enrollmentNo on an imported user → 409; email-already-a-non-matching-user → 409; new registration whose enrollmentNo exists → 409). status defaults ACTIVE at the DB so no code change is required for it; optionally set admissionDate/best-effort programId on the create path. Do NOT weaken any check; the enrollmentNo UNIQUE backstop is unchanged.

apps/api/src/routes/student.ts: add GET /me/profile, GET /me/academic, GET /me/services — all preHandler [requirePermission('students.view_own')] (NO requireModuleActive), inside withTenant, resolving the owned record via getStudentInTenant(userId, institutionId, tx) (NEVER a request-supplied id). /me/profile returns identity + current academic info (prefer structuredProgram name/code when programId set else free-text program; resolved academicSession + currentTerm name/ordinal else free-text semester), status, admissionDate, department. /me/academic is a focused current session/term/program view reusing the Phase-1 current-session read. /me/services reads tx.institutionModule.findMany({ where: { institutionId, state: 'ACTIVE' } }) and maps each ACTIVE module key to its self-service entry points (e.g. campus_movement -> gate-pass actions); ENTITLED/SUSPENDED/NOT_ENTITLED modules do not appear.
Build gate: cd apps/api && npx tsc must compile clean; npm run build (repo root) must succeed.

Unit test: add apps/api/src/services/__tests__/student-sis.test.ts covering each transition's changeType + previous/new snapshot, the updateStudentSchema.strict() rejection of a forbidden key, and resolveImportRow returning update/create/skip for existing-vs-new enrollmentNo. DB-free (plain inputs / mocked client).
acceptance_criteria: cd apps/api && npx tsc compiles clean (the new students.ts routes, student-sis.ts service, folded-in admin.ts/auth.ts/student.ts, and server.ts registration all type-check).
npm run build (repo root) succeeds across workspaces.
studentAdminRoutes is registered in server.ts at prefix /api/students; self-service /me/* routes are on student.ts at /api/student; no route is wired to requireModuleActive.
The folded-in bulk-import resolves by enrollmentNo first (update, not duplicate), writes students.student.imported, and keeps the per-row try/catch backstop; /register collision checks are unchanged.
cd apps/api && npx vitest run src/services/__tests__/student-sis.test.ts — all green.
findings:
DONE & VERIFIED. apps/api `npx tsc` clean; `npm run build` (repo root) = 3 successful, 3 total (@campusgate/shared, @campusgate/web, @campusgate/api all built; no errors — the turbo run's trailing 'Finishing writing to cache' spinner held the terminal open past the task completion, the task itself exited 0); `npx vitest run src/services/__tests__/student-sis.test.ts` = 14 tests passed. No schema/migration/shared changes were needed (FEAT-001 already shipped the enums, StudentProfile fields, StudentProfileHistory/StudentDocument models, the students.* permissions + role bindings, the eight students.student.* audit keys, and ALL the SIS zod schemas incl. updateStudentSchema.strict()). Prisma client regenerated from repo root (6.19.3) before building; nothing committed from node_modules. Committed LOCALLY on main, no push.

FILES ADDED:
  - apps/api/src/services/student-sis.ts — pure, DB-free transition service (mirrors module-system.ts/academic-session.ts). Exports: StudentSnapshot + HistorySnapshotPayload interfaces; createdPayload/updatedPayload/programAssignedPayload/enrolledPayload/promotedPayload/transferredPayload/deactivatedPayload (each returns a full previous*/new* snapshot payload with the right changeType); resolveImportRow(existingByEnrollmentNo, existingEmailUser, row) -> {action:'update',studentProfileId}|{action:'create'}|{action:'skip',reason} (resolve-first: enrollmentNo identity key wins over email). No Prisma client inside — takes plain inputs.
  - apps/api/src/routes/students.ts — exports studentAdminRoutes(app); single top-level authenticate hook; each route requirePermission('students.<x>') ONLY, NO requireModuleActive (Decision A); every handler inside withTenant(institutionId from request.user); every lifecycle mutation writes a StudentProfileHistory row (payload from student-sis.ts) AND recordAuditEvent(..., tx) in the SAME tx; DENIED audits (no tx) on 409/400 reject paths per §5.7.
  - apps/api/src/services/__tests__/student-sis.test.ts — 14 DB-free tests: each transition's changeType + prev/new snapshot; updateStudentSchema.strict() rejects enrollmentNo/status; resolveImportRow update/create/skip (incl. enrollmentNo-wins-over-email).

FILES MODIFIED:
  - apps/api/src/server.ts — import studentAdminRoutes from ./routes/students.js; `await app.register(studentAdminRoutes, { prefix: "/api/students" });` directly after the studentRoutes /api/student registration. No path collision (admin SIS /api/students/*, self-service /api/student/me/*).
  - apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts — /students/bulk-import folded onto the new model via resolveImportRow (resolve-first by enrollmentNo BEFORE email): update-in-place existing enrollmentNo (new results.updated counter, writes a StudentProfileHistory UPDATED row, NO second profile row), skip on email-belongs-to-different-user (unchanged error string), else create User+StudentProfile with explicit status='ACTIVE' + best-effort programId from courseCode/program (never fails the row). Per-row try/catch kept (enrollmentNo UNIQUE backstop). Summarizing audit action switched admin.students.imported -> students.student.imported; metadata now {created,updated,skipped}. Import of resolveImportRow added.
  - apps/api/src/routes/auth.ts — /register PRESERVED all three collision checks unchanged (mismatched enrollmentNo on imported user 409; non-matching email 409; new-registration existing enrollmentNo 409). Added ONLY best-effort programId resolution (Program by code/name in the department's institution) on the new self-register create path; status still defaults ACTIVE at the DB (no code change). No check weakened.
  - apps/api/src/routes/student.ts — added GET /me/profile, /me/academic, /me/services, all requirePermission('students.view_own') ONLY (NO requireModuleActive), inside withTenant, owned record via getStudentInTenant(userId, institutionId, tx) (NEVER a request id). /me/profile: identity + prefer structuredProgram over free-text program, resolved academicSession + currentTerm (name/ordinal) else free-text semester, status, admissionDate, department. /me/academic: focused current session/term/program, falling back to the institution's single ACTIVE session (Phase-1 read) when the student has no linked session. /me/services: reads tx.institutionModule.findMany({where:{institutionId,state:'ACTIVE'}}) and maps each ACTIVE module key to its self-service entry points.

FINAL ROUTE PATHS + PERMISSION GATES (all requirePermission-only, no requireModuleActive):
  ADMIN SIS at /api/students (studentAdminRoutes):
    POST   /                   students.create     (409 enrollmentNo, 409 email; create User STUDENT+ACTIVE + StudentProfile best-effort programId; history CREATED; audit students.student.created)
    PATCH  /:id                students.update     (updateStudentSchema.strict() -> 400 'field not editable'; only parsed permitted keys passed to update; history UPDATED; audit students.student.updated)
    POST   /:id/assign-program students.update     (Program in-tenant + status ACTIVE else 400 'unknown or inactive program'; optional refreshProgramText -> program=program.name; history PROGRAM_CHANGED; audit students.student.program_assigned)
    POST   /:id/enroll         students.enroll     (session in-tenant + term belongs to session else 400 'invalid session or term'; set academicSessionId+currentTermId, status ENROLLED or ACTIVE if activate:true, semester = body.semester ?? term.ordinal; history ENROLLED; audit students.student.enrolled)
    POST   /:id/promote        students.promote    (optional target currentTermId validated in-tenant else 400 'invalid target term'; advance currentTermId/semester, status ACTIVE; NO rewrite/delete; history PROMOTED w/ previous term+semester; audit students.student.promoted)
    POST   /:id/transfer       students.update     (new departmentId and/or programId validated in-tenant else 400 'unknown department or program'; program change refreshes free-text program=program.name; history TRANSFERRED; audit students.student.transferred)
    POST   /:id/deactivate     students.deactivate (deactivateStudentSchema.status validated against StudentStatus enum else 400 'invalid status'; NO delete route; history DEACTIVATED w/ optional reason; audit students.student.deactivated)
    GET    /                   students.view       (listStudentsQuerySchema: q contains name/enrollmentNo/rollNumber case-insensitive, status/programId/departmentId filters, page/pageSize<=100, orderBy [{createdAt:'asc'},{id:'asc'}]; HOD narrowed to departmentScope)
    GET    /:id                students.view       (detail with department + structuredProgram + academicSession + currentTerm included; HOD dept-scoped; 404 'student not found')
    GET    /:id/history        students.view       (append-only history newest-first {createdAt:'desc'}, paginated page/pageSize<=100)
  SELF-SERVICE at /api/student (studentRoutes, additive): GET /me/profile, GET /me/academic, GET /me/services — all students.view_own, own-record via getStudentInTenant, ACTIVE-module-only for /me/services.

HOD DEPARTMENT SCOPE: helper departmentScopeFilter(request) returns { departmentId: request.auth.departmentScope } only when roles include HOD and NOT ADMIN and a scope is set; merged into every students.ts where-clause (list/detail/history + all :id mutations) so an HOD only sees/acts within their department. ADMIN and others see the whole tenant.

/me/services MODULE -> ENTRY-POINT MAP SHAPE: response is { services: Array<{ module: string; entryPoints: string[] }> }, one element per ACTIVE institution_modules row (ENTITLED/SUSPENDED/NOT_ENTITLED excluded). The entry-point lookup is a const SELF_SERVICE_ENTRY_POINTS: Record<string,{entryPoints:string[]}> in student.ts; currently seeded only for campus_movement -> ['gate-pass.request','gate-pass.active','gate-pass.history','gate-pass.allowance','gate-pass.reliability']. An ACTIVE module with no map entry returns entryPoints: [] (so new modules surface as soon as they go ACTIVE, without a code change, and can be enriched later).

HISTORY WRITE SHAPE (students.ts writeHistory helper): tx.studentProfileHistory.create with institutionId, studentProfileId, changeType, all 14 previous*/new* columns from the payload, actorUserId=request.user.userId, actorMembershipId=request.auth?.membershipId ?? null, reason (deactivate passes body reason; bulk-import update passes 'bulk-import re-import update'). createdAt is DB-default. metadata left unset (sanitizeMetadata drops non-scalars anyway; no PII dumped).

AUDIT SHAPE: recordAuditEvent inside the tx on success (result SUCCESS) and, on the 409/400 reject branches that have a resource context, a SEPARATE recordAuditEvent WITHOUT tx (privilegedPrisma) with result DENIED (§5.7). resourceType 'StudentProfile'; actorRoleKey = request.auth?.roles[0] ?? request.user.role; the bulk-import summarizing event is resourceType 'User' action students.student.imported.

FOR FEAT-003 (tests): the live SIS surface to exercise is now wired. Escape-suite extension per FEAT-001 findings still applies (add student_profile_history + student_documents to RLS_TABLES; student_profile_history -> append-only EXPECTED_POLICIES [tenant_isolation_select, student_profile_history_tenant_insert]; student_documents falls through to DEFAULT_POLICIES standard pair; seed student_documents in the helper but NOT student_profile_history — the append-only trigger blocks adminClient teardown). Regression suite (§9.1) targets: GatePass request->approve->exit->return against a student created the new way; allowance/reliability unchanged for status=ACTIVE + null structured links vs populated links; a GRADUATED student still resolves for historical pass reads (no row deleted). The bulk-import re-import test (§11.3): POST a row with an existing enrollmentNo -> results.updated increments, NO second profile row, a StudentProfileHistory UPDATED row written, enrollmentNo UNIQUE never hit. Cross-feature catalogue-sync dir string: 20261027161616_phase2_sis (already in SEEDING_MIGRATION_DIRS from FEAT-001). NOTE: /register is exercised on privilegedPrisma (pre-tenant), so its programId best-effort resolution is NOT inside withTenant — consistent with the existing live /register pattern.
